title: Close-up road alignment fix, unguided ML & GPS HUD
features: Fixed close-up road alignment at Z6–Z9: display-only, camera-coupled Z6-reference visual road matching keeps the vehicle icon and active magenta route cleanly centred on roads at cropped zooms Z7–Z9 using heading alignment, active-route corridor preference, service-road filtering, dual-carriageway hysteresis and smooth easing (zero map rebuilds, raw GPS/routing/ML untouched).

Unguided local ML learning: Preferred Nearby POIs, Usual Parking (including habitual car parks with no saved places nearby), POI-named stops/predictions and Usual Route shortcuts learn without an active route.
Unguided commute alerts: Likely traffic ahead, Frequent slowdown ahead and Cold-weather slowdown ahead warn without a route, with dynamic smooth-pass hazard decay and age expiry.
Weekday vs. weekend weighting for destination predictions, plus Adaptive Auto-zoom aligned to Z9–Z4 hysteresis bands with a 20-second sustained-override guard.

Live expandable GPS HUD inside the top clock pill (HH:MM:SS seconds, Day/Night compass dial, accuracy, satellites, altitude and coordinates), adapting cleanly to popups and menus — toggled by double-OK or console REPEAT.
Expanded Auto zoom and manual driving zoom across Z9–Z4 with speed hysteresis, close-up Z7–Z9 street names and tighter View diversion / View route Explore framing.
